about.title: my design journey
about.subTitle: Learning, creating, and growing through digital experiences.
about.descriptionOne: My interest in UI/UX Design began during my undergraduate studies, when I started to understand the importance of planning and structuring projects before development. Throughout several courses, I had the opportunity to create prototypes to organize ideas, validate solutions, and transform concepts into functional digital products.
about.descriptionTwo: Building on these experiences, I deepened my knowledge of UI/UX Design, seeking to better understand the interface design process and the importance of creating solutions centered on users' needs. This journey strengthened my passion for the field and allowed me to apply these concepts in both academic and professional projects.
about.descriptionThree: Since then, I have dedicated myself to UI/UX Design courses to improve my skills and knowledge. Today, I continue to learn and grow continuously.
